name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with domain=ai. Descriptor accurately states behavior: find the nearest runtime char matching the team selector and walk char_idx toward it (advance). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Battle AI movement helper: find the nearest alive char matching the team selector and walk the acting char toward it; returns whether a move happened.
logic_summary: Reads self position from runtime_char[char_idx] (bPos_x/bPos_y). best_dist=0xFFFF, best_x=-1. Scans scan=0..party_member_count-1: with asymmetric team filter (team==0 picks chars with bTeam!=0; team!=0 picks chars with bTeam==0), computes Manhattan distance abs(self_x-pos_x)+abs(self_y-pos_y); tracks the minimum and records that char's (x,y) into best_x/best_y. If no candidate found (best_x stays -1) return 0. If the nearest target is already on self's tile (best_x==self_x && best_y==self_y) return 0 (no move). Otherwise: battle_anim_phase=0, pan cursor to char, call fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile(best_x,best_y,char_idx,team); set moved=1 iff the walk returned non-zero; battle_anim_phase=1; return moved.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Runtime index of the acting AI character. Used to read self position from runtime_char[char_idx], pan the cursor to it, and as the walk source.
params.reason: Accurate, conventional name for a runtime_char index; no address residue.

params.name: team
params.semantics: Asymmetric team selector used as the candidate filter (team==0 -> pick bTeam!=0; team!=0 -> pick bTeam==0). Caller (fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher) passes its ctx_flag; the value is also forwarded as the ctx arg to fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile.
params.reason: Name matches body usage (purely a team filter) and is consistent with sibling AI helpers (team_selector / team_filter); not address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 if a move was performed (target found, not already on self tile, and fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile returned non-zero); 0 otherwise (no candidate, already at target tile, or walk failed).

notes: Decompile shows a confusing 'moved = (moved_flag = best_x/best_y) != 0' artifact, but disassembly confirms the actual returned 'moved' (stored at [ESP], init 0) is set to 1 only via TEST EAX/JZ on fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile's return value (00013fb4-00013fb8). The src already models this correctly as 'if (walk_result != 0) moved = 1;'. No logic change made (refine touches name-judgement + comments only). Src comment block (btl_aitg.c lines 629-634) was already concise and accurate -> kept. Ghidra plate is detailed, consistent with src, and not contradictory -> left untouched.
